welcome.title: Gathernet
welcome.privacyNote: No email. No phone number. Your recovery phrase is your key.

create.nameHint: Your display name is only shown to people you connect with. You can change it anytime.
create.phraseWarning: Write these 12 words down on paper, in order. They are the only way to recover your account. Anyone who has them has your account — Gathernet cannot reset or recover them for you.
create.confirmError: That word doesn't match. Check your paper and try again.
create.unlockHint: This password protects your keys on this device only. It is not stored anywhere else and cannot be reset — if you forget it, restore with your recovery phrase.

restore.title: Restore your account
restore.hint: Enter your 12-word recovery phrase, separated by spaces.
restore.invalid: That's not a valid recovery phrase.
restore.notFound: No account found for this phrase.

unlock.title: Welcome back
unlock.forgetConfirm: This removes your keys and messages from this browser. You will need your recovery phrase to get back in. Continue?

connect.title: Connect with {{name}}
connect.messagePlaceholder: Add a short message (who you are, why you'd like to connect)
connect.errNotConnectable: You can't connect with this person
connect.errNoRecipients: This person has no device to receive the request

friends.title: Friends
friends.empty: No friends yet. Invite someone you trust.
friends.removeConfirm: Remove {{name}}? You can reconnect later with a new invite.
friends.blockHint: Pause invites from {{name}} for a while. It lifts on its own — you can also lift it early.

addFriend.title: Add a friend
addFriend.inviteHint: Share this code or QR with someone you trust. It works once and expires in 7 days.
addFriend.invalidCode: That code is invalid or was already used.
addFriend.scanHint: Point your camera at your friend's QR code.
addFriend.scanUnsupported: Camera scanning isn't supported in this browser — enter the code instead.

chat.cannotSend: Encryption is still being set up for this chat.
chat.removedByModerator: This message was removed by a moderator
chat.reportNoMods: This channel has no moderators to receive reports
chat.viewOnceViewing: This disappears after you close the chat

pins.title: Pinned ({{count}})
pins.remindNote: Reminders are best-effort — delivered when your community is active, and never reveal the time to the server.

settings.title: Settings
settings.revokeConfirm: Revoke {{name}}? It will be signed out immediately and removed from your encrypted chats.
settings.addDevice: To add a device, open Gathernet there and choose “I have a recovery phrase”.

push.title: Notifications
push.explainer: Get notified when the app is closed. The server can't see message content — a notification only tells your device the kind of activity, never who or what.
push.blocked: Notifications are blocked in your browser settings — allow them there first.
push.disguiseNote: Change the notification's title and icon. Note: some systems still show “Gathernet” as the source app — that part comes from the install and can't be changed here.

qr.unsupported: Camera scanning isn't supported in this browser — enter the code instead.

scopes.identity: Will see your display name and an app-specific user ID. Won't see your account key, your friends, or your messages.
scopes.storage: Can save its own data to your account. The app receives a key that can only read its own saves — never your messages or other apps' data.
scopes.rooms: Can open real-time rooms with the people you play or work with. Won't see who your friends are.
scopes.friendsInvite: Can ask you to send a friend invite. Won't add anyone without your confirmation.

apps.openerMissing: This page must be opened by an app requesting access.
apps.invalidRequest: This access request is invalid or incomplete.
apps.authorizeFailed: The app could not be authorized. Close this window and try again from the app.
apps.approved: Access granted — you can return to the app.
apps.denied: Access denied — you can close this window.
apps.rememberedConsent: You already approved this app — finishing up…
apps.backfillHint: This app wants to save data under your account. To create its storage key on this device, enter your 12-word recovery phrase once. The phrase never leaves this device.
apps.backfillMismatch: That phrase doesn't match this account.
apps.connectHint: Enter the code the app shows you, or scan its QR code.
apps.codeInvalid: That code is invalid or has expired.
apps.scanHint: Point your camera at the QR code the app shows.
apps.connectSuccess: Connected! You can return to the app.
apps.connectDenied: Request denied. The app was not connected.
apps.connectWithCode: Connect an app with a code
apps.revokeConfirm: Revoke access for {{name}}? The app will be signed out of your account.

pwa.updateAvailable: A new version of Gathernet is available.

communities.title: Communities
communities.empty: You're not in any community yet. Create one or join with a code.
communities.invalidCode: That code is invalid, expired, or already used.
communities.alreadyMember: You're already a member of this community.
communities.selectChannel: Select a channel to start chatting.
communities.deleteChannelConfirm: Delete this channel? Its history is removed for everyone.
communities.channelLocked: This is a leaders-only channel. You don't have access.
communities.channelUntrusted: This channel has an unverified member. Sending is paused until every member's identity checks out.
communities.channelRotationPending: Sending paused — the channel key just rotated. Waiting for the new key so nothing is sent under the old one.
communities.inviteHint: Share this code with people you want in the community. Invite-only — there is no public directory.
communities.removeConfirm: Remove {{name}} from the community? They lose access to all channels.
communities.requestToJoinHint: This channel admits new members by request.
communities.waitingApprovalHint: A moderator will review your request to join this channel.
communities.youreInvited: You've been invited to this channel.
communities.noMembersToInvite: Everyone is already in this channel.
communities.channelCodeHint: Anyone with this code can join the channel.
communities.avatarNoKey: This device can't encrypt images for this community.
communities.avatarTooLarge: That image is too large. Try a smaller one.

pinPolicy.label: Who can pin
pinPolicy.everyoneHint: Any member can pin a message directly.
pinPolicy.moderatorsHint: Members suggest pins; a moderator approves them.

encryptionMode.label: Channel type
encryptionMode.mlsHint: Best for small or sensitive channels: per-message forward secrecy and instant removal. Recommended.
encryptionMode.groupKeyHint: For big channels (thousands to 100k). Slightly weaker per-message forward secrecy; can't be changed later.

communities.readOnlyHint: Only moderators can post in this channel.
communities.mutedHint: You have been muted in this channel.
